mapper.insert: insert into comment (comment_content, board_id, member_id, parent_comment_id, is_admin_answer) values (#{commentContent}, #{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{isAdminAnswer})
mapper.select: select c.comment_id, c.comment_content, c.board_id, c.member_id, c.reg_date, c.parent_comment_id, c.del_yn, c.is_admin_answer, COALESCE(m.member_name, '알 수 없음') as member_name from comment c left join member m on c.member_id = m.member_id where board_id = #{boardId} order by reg_date desc
select count(*) from comment where parent_comment_id = #{commentId} and del_yn = 'N'
mapper.delete: delete from comment where board_id = #{boardId} and parent_comment_id is not null
delete from comment where board_id = #{boardId} and parent_comment_id is null
mapper.select: select c.comment_id, c.comment_content, c.reg_date, c.board_id, COALESCE(m.member_name, '알 수 없음') as member_name from comment c left join member m on b.member_id = m.member_id join board b on b.board_id = c.board_id order by c.reg_date desc limit #{start}, #{count}
